numeric_complexity_contract.reference: per group, copy the scores, sort them in decreasing order and add the first k
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: per group, keep a size-k min-heap of scores (push, pop the smallest when larger than k) and sum the heap; compare totals with a strict greater-than so the first best index wins
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(G log k) time/O(k) extra space, G = total group size

problems.title: Maximize Task Scheduling Within Time Limit

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: sort the durations and simulate min(n * m, number of tasks) slot end times in a plain list, scanning the list for the earliest-free slot for every task
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: sort the durations and keep the slot end times in a min-heap of size min(n * m, number of tasks); pop the earliest, stop when it plus the duration exceeds 60, otherwise push the new end time
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(t log t) time/O(t) space, t = number of tasks
